mechanism: Vedolizumab (immunosuppressant) may increase risk of mefloquine-related neuropsychiatric and CNS adverse effects through additive immunosuppression and potential impaired drug clearance in setting of gut-homing lymphocyte inhibition.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if mefloquine prophylaxis is necessary, ensure close neuropsychiatric monitoring and consider alternative antimalarial agents with better safety profiles in immunosuppressed patients.
